preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c_i <= 10**9 for c_i in c)
preconditions.description: Each vertex price c_i is a non-negative integer not exceeding 10^9.
The tree has exactly n-1 edges, forming a connected acyclic graph.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the valid range.
The input edges form a valid tree with root at vertex 1.

postconditions.description: The first line of output contains the minimum cost s and the number of vertices k in at least one optimal set.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for v in output_vertices)
postconditions.description: The vertices in the second line are distinct and within the valid range.
The vertices in the second line are printed in strictly increasing order.
The set of vertices in the second line is part of at least one optimal solution with cost s.
The cost s is the minimum possible cost to guarantee Arkady's win.
